actions.approve_task.description: Approves an inbox task in Workday.
actions.approve_task.props.taskId.descri: The ID of the inbox task to approve.
actions.call_operation.description: Calls a Workday REST sub-resource or SOAP operation (e.g. approve, close, submit).
actions.call_operation.props.module.desc: Workday functional area: Recruiting, Onboarding, or HR Services & Time Tracking.
actions.call_operation.props.operationNa: REST sub-resource or SOAP operation path, e.g. `/cases/{id}/reopen` or `Close_Job_Requisition`.
actions.call_operation.props.soapBody.de: Raw SOAP operation XML, used only for SOAP operations. Leave empty to send an empty operation element.
actions.call_operation.props.soapService: Workday Web Service that owns the operation. Required for SOAP operations.
actions.call_operation.props.soapVersion: Workday Web Services version for this call, e.g. `v45.0`. Leave empty to use the connection version (default v47.0).
actions.change_job.description: Changes the job for a worker in Workday.
actions.change_job.props.effectiveDate.d: Effective date of the job change (YYYY-MM-DD).
actions.change_job.props.reasonId.descri: The reason for the job change.
actions.change_job.props.workerId.descri: The ID of the worker whose job to change.
actions.create_job_requisition.descripti: Creates a new job requisition in Workday.
actions.create_job_requisition.props.job: The title for the job posting.
actions.create_job_requisition.props.pri: Primary location WID, also used as the primary job posting location.
actions.create_job_requisition.props.rea: Creation reason as a General_Event_Subcategory_ID (e.g. `Create_Job_Requisition_Administrative_Non_Competitive_Fill_No_Recruiting_Required`) or a WID.
actions.create_job_requisition.props.rec: Date to start recruiting (YYYY-MM-DD). Required by Workday.
actions.create_job_requisition.props.sup: The supervisory organization for the requisition.
actions.create_job_requisition.props.tar: Target date for hiring (YYYY-MM-DD). Required by Workday.
actions.create_job_requisition.props.wor: Worker sub-type reference ID (Employee_Type_ID), e.g. `Regular`. Required when the tenant has no default.
Worker type reference ID (Worker_Type_ID), e.g. `EE`. Required when the tenant has no default.
actions.create_pre_hire.description: Creates a new pre-hire record in Workday.
actions.create_pre_hire.props.country.de: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3 country code (e.g., "USA", "GBR", "DEU"). Required by Workday.
actions.create_pre_hire.props.email.desc: Email address (at least one of email, phone, or address is required).
Legal first name of the pre-hire.
actions.create_pre_hire.props.lastName.d: Legal last name of the pre-hire.
actions.create_supplier_credit_memo.desc: Creates a new supplier credit memo in Workday.
actions.create_time_off_request.descript: Creates a new time off request in Workday.
actions.create_time_off_request.props.en: End date of the time off (YYYY-MM-DD).
actions.create_time_off_request.props.ho: Hours requested for each weekday in the range (default: 8). Weekends are skipped.
actions.create_time_off_request.props.st: Start date of the time off (YYYY-MM-DD).
actions.create_time_off_request.props.ti: Time off type as a Time_Off_Type_ID (e.g. `Vacation_Hours`, `Sick_Hours`) or a WID.
actions.create_time_off_request.props.wo: The ID of the worker requesting time off.
actions.create_update_custom_object.desc: Creates or updates a Workday custom object record.
actions.create_update_custom_object.prop: JSON payload for create or update operations.
The custom object definition; its value is the definition alias, e.g. `apTestInfo`.
Record ID to update. Leave blank to create; the body must then reference the record it is attached to, e.g. `{ "worker": { "id": "..." } }`.
actions.create_worker_time_block.descrip: Creates a new worker time block in Workday.
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.find_purchase_order.description: Finds a purchase order by ID in Workday using WQL.
actions.find_purchase_order.props.purcha: The ID of the purchase order to find.
actions.find_records_wql.description: Executes a Workday Query Language (WQL) query and returns the results.
actions.find_records_wql.props.query.des: The Workday Query Language (WQL) query to execute (e.g., "SELECT workdayID, fullName FROM allWorkers").
actions.find_supplier.description: Finds a supplier by ID in Workday using WQL.
actions.find_supplier.props.supplierId.d: The ID of the supplier to find.
actions.find_supplier_invoice.descriptio: Finds a supplier invoice by its Workday ID or Supplier Invoice ID.
actions.find_supplier_invoice.props.invo: The invoice Workday ID (WID) or Supplier Invoice ID, e.g. `SUPPLIER_INVOICE-11-894`. The invoice number (e.g. `SINV-10000885`) is not accepted.
actions.find_supplier_payment.descriptio: Finds supplier payments in Workday using WQL.
actions.find_supplier_payment.props.paym: The ID of a specific payment to find.
actions.get_business_object_details_batc: Retrieves details for one or more business objects by ID in a single step.
Workday functional area: Recruiting, Onboarding, or HR Services & Time Tracking. Only used with the REST source.
One or more record IDs to retrieve: WIDs, or with the SOAP source also the object ID (e.g. Employee ID for workers).
Workday Web Services (SOAP) reaches every object in the list and needs ISU credentials on the connection. REST covers fewer objects.
actions.get_custom_objects.description: Retrieves a custom object record by its record ID or, for single-instance objects, by the parent record ID.
actions.get_custom_objects.props.definit: The custom object definition; its value is the definition alias, e.g. `apTestInfo`.
actions.get_custom_objects.props.objectI: The custom object record ID, or for a single-instance object the ID of the record it is attached to (e.g. the worker WID).
actions.get_report.description: Runs a Workday custom report through Reports-as-a-Service (RaaS).
actions.get_report.props.format.descript: JSON returns the rows; CSV returns the report as CSV text.
actions.get_report.props.reportId.descri: The custom report's RaaS URL (on the report: Actions → Web Service → View URLs, copy the JSON link) or `owner/report_name`, e.g. `lmcneil/PT_Workers`. The report must have Enable As Web Service ticked. Prompt values in a pasted URL are kept.
actions.get_report.props.reportParameter: Prompt values keyed by the prompt XML alias, e.g. `{ "Start_Date": "2026-10-01", "Organizations!WID": "<WID>" }`. A list is sent as multiple values. These override prompts in a pasted URL.
actions.get_report_wql_batch.description: Executes a WQL query and returns all rows (use for report-style datasets).
actions.get_report_wql_batch.props.query: Workday Query Language query. Include a date/timestamp column for polling triggers.

The ID of the pre-hire or applicant to hire.
actions.list_custom_object_definitions_b: Lists all custom object definitions available in your Workday tenant.
actions.search_business_object_batch.des: Searches business objects with pagination and returns all matching records.
actions.search_business_object_batch.pro: Maximum number of records to return with the SOAP source (default 100, max 1000). Workday records are large, so keep this low.
Workday functional area: Recruiting, Onboarding, or HR Services & Time Tracking. Only used with the REST source.

actions.update_business_object.props.bod: JSON payload for create or update operations.
actions.update_business_object.props.mod: Workday functional area: Recruiting, Onboarding, or HR Services & Time Tracking.
actions.update_business_object.props.obj: Workday ID of the record to update.
actions.update_supplier.description: Updates an existing supplier in Workday.
actions.update_supplier.props.supplierId: The ID of the supplier to update.
actions.update_supplier.props.taxId.desc: Supplier tax identification number. Needs Tax ID Type. Adds or replaces the tax ID of that type only; other tax IDs are kept.
Workday Tax ID Type reference ID, e.g. `USA-EIN`. Required when Tax ID is set.
actions.update_supplier_invoice.descript: Updates an existing supplier invoice in Workday.
actions.update_supplier_invoice.props.in: The ID of the supplier invoice to update.
